actions.action: Preview edits through the token dependency graph
actions.mechanism: Resolve current and proposed values per brand and theme, following aliases and stopping at explicit overrides.
actions.implementation: Evaluate edits in a draft. Traverse reverse references; list changed resolved tokens and affected rendered pairs. Flag cycles with their reference paths.
actions.check: Test a three-level alias, an overridden branch, and a cycle; verify propagation, unchanged overrides, and explicit resolution errors.
actions.risk: Incorrect context resolution can hide downstream changes.

actions.action: Keep brand overrides explicit and traceable
actions.mechanism: Store overrides as independent values with provenance, rather than flattening them into inherited palette values.
actions.implementation: Display each override’s brand, source token, and rationale. Require an explicit, separately recorded operation to modify or remove it.
actions.check: Edit a shared base token; confirm intentional brand values remain unchanged and their provenance remains inspectable in the proposal.
actions.risk: Preserved overrides may still create problematic rendered pairs.

actions.action: Gate publishing on a pair-review checklist
actions.mechanism: Evaluate actual foreground/background uses separately, so a token’s safety is never inferred from its name or role.
actions.implementation: For affected pairs, show brand, theme, roles, contrast results, and applicable thresholds. Require review for failures, regressions, or indeterminate results; block unresolved cycles.
actions.check: Use one token as both text and background; verify both uses appear and unreviewed flagged pairs prevent publishing.
actions.risk: Color checks alone cannot establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Compare current and proposed values without color dependence
actions.mechanism: Pair synchronized previews with textual values, dependency explanations, and labeled change states rather than colored indicators alone.
actions.implementation: Add a comparison table showing token paths, brand/theme, current/proposed values, contrast ratios, and override status; link each row to its rendered example.
actions.check: In grayscale and keyboard-only testing, identify changed values, affected pairs, and preserved overrides without interpreting swatch colors.
actions.risk: Large comparison tables need filtering without hiding review obligations.
